system.description:
The Kiasyd's study of reality has curdled into knowledge that, to any mind not sharing her altered senses, is indistinguishable from madness. She poses a single penetrating philosophical question — a riddle so arcane it ensnares the listener, driving some to self-injury and others deeper into incoherence until it is solved.

Speak to a subject who can hear and understand you, then make a challenge pitting your Social Traits against her Mental Traits. If you win, she falls into a trance and can take no actions, her whole mind consumed by the riddle. Once per half-hour she makes a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty of your Mental Traits (retest Occult, with free Occult retest Traits equal to her number of Dementation powers); on three wins she solves the riddle and breaks free. Each failed retest sends her tearing at herself for one level of lethal damage. You may end the trance at any time by revealing the answer.
